public44.interpretation: Separate unprofiled single runs: modest reduction, not a controlled speedup or the 20x goal.

focusedProduction.scope: Source-initialized full C/JS program, native NHLUA helpers and real NHLOBJ callbacks on 13 object-class rows with all 25 source fields.

cDriverOpcodeOracle.scope: Same unchanged compiled C caller: callbacks/reentry/errors, byte strings/outparams, userdata/growth, GC/finalizers, allocator failures/limits/recovery, bounded transport failure.

allocationRuntime.scope: Original six allocation policies including alignment, wrap/failure/growth/ownership and nested runtime isolation; additional unchanged runtime/RNG/MD4/strbuf checks.

ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

limits: The 20x goal and zero-bridge/zero-C-heap ordinary-turn gate remain unmet.
Allocator-backed physical Lua storage is retained; no allocation accounting or allocator policy is bypassed.
Nonzero C continuations remain unsupported as before.
